145	   └── pdf_to_images(pdf_path=projects/{project}/paper/main.pdf, pages="1-N", dpi=200)

162	   └── check_provenance_completeness(project=...)
163	   └── 返回：tier_distribution / untracked_numbers / invalidated_claims
164	   └── 关键阈值：
165	        - Tier 3 占比 > 30% → 必须汇报 Director（红线，不得静默交付）
166	        - Tier X（invalidated，实验失败/被作废）≥ 1 条 → critical：claim 失去支撑，汇报 Director 决策是否改 claim

171	
172	三件套全部跑完后**统一**汇报（不要分三次发），把所有 critical/warning 列在一处便于 Director 决策：
173	
174	```
175	paper_agent_post_to_director(
176	  text="[写作进展] Step 5 收尾完成
177	         迭代轮数：{N}/5
178	         最终 overall：{score}
179	         checklist：全部 PASS / 还有 X 条 FAIL（已修复 / 待 Director 决策）
180	
181	         ===== 视觉检查 =====
182	         检查页数：{n}/{total}
183	         结论：PASS / 发现 X 条 critical + Y 条 warning
184	         {若有 critical：逐条列出 page + 描述}
185	
186	         ===== 引用验证 =====
187	         总数 X 条，已验证 Y 条
188	         critical：missing_bib X 条 + 疑似幻觉 Y 条（已尝试 WebSearch 二次验证 → 结果）
189	         warning：mismatch X 条
190	         {若有 critical：列出条目 + 已采取的修复}
191	
192	         ===== Provenance 覆盖 =====
193	         Tier 分布：T1 {a}% / T2 {b}% / T3 {c}% / TX {d}%
194	         {若 T3 > 30% 或 TX ≥ 1：列出受影响的 claim/figure/table}
195	         未追踪数字：X 个（详见 untracked_numbers）
196	
197	         ===== 建议 =====
198	         {以下任选其一}
199	         A. 视觉/引用/provenance 全部 PASS → 建议提交审稿（submit_paper_to_review）
200	         B. 存在 critical → 请 Director 决策：{具体问题列表 + 建议修复方向}
201	         C. provenance 红线触发 → 请 Director 决定：补实验 / 改 claim / 接受现状",
202	  project=...
203	)
204	```
205	
206	Director 决定是否调 `submit_paper_to_review`——Paper Agent **不**主动调，这是 Director 的权限。
207	
208	### 红线（Step 5e 不可绕过）
209	
210	1. **三件套必须全跑**：跳过任一项直接汇报 = 违规，被 Director 打回时不接受"我以为不必要"
211	2. **critical 不静默**：视觉 critical / verify_references critical / Tier X ≥ 1 / Tier 3 > 30% 必须显式写进汇报
212	3. **不主动提交审稿**：哪怕全 PASS 也只能"建议提交"，submit_paper_to_review 是 Director 权限
213	4. **修复后必须复验**：自己修了 missing_bib → 重跑 verify_references；补 provenance → 重跑 check_provenance_completeness
214	5. **Patch 模式走 Phase E**：Patch 的收尾在 Phase E（max 3 轮 Reviewer），不复用 Step 5e 全套；Phase E 自己做 check_provenance_completeness + verify_references，视觉检查可选
215	
216	## 硬约束（与 Paper Agent 红线一致）
217	
218	1. **修改前必 git commit**——没有 commit 不开新一轮，避免 revert 失败
219	2. **未验证引用不进 .bib**——Reviewer 指出新引用需求时，先 verify_references 再写入
220	3. **checklist FAIL 项必须修复**——不参与"连续两轮无新增 critical"的轮数计数，但下一轮必须解决
221	4. **overall 下降必 revert**——不允许"将就一下"
222	5. **不自行降 claim**——claim 无支撑是 Director 决策，Paper Agent 只能改表述强度，不能改 claim 内容
223	6. **Patch / Dream 模式不走本 skill**——Patch 走 Phase E（max 3 轮），Dream 跳过 Reviewer 迭代
224	
225	## 与 Reviewer 评分模板的合约
226	
227	Reviewer 在 `prompts/roles/reviewer.md` §5.3 已规定返回格式：
228	
229	```
230	[写作评审] 轮次 N/5
231	维度评分（1-4）：Originality / Clarity / Soundness / Significance / Presentation
232	Overall（1-10）：
233	## 用户自定义必查项（如审查请求含 paper_checklist）
234	- [chk_id]: PASS / FAIL — 理由
235	## 具体问题
236	- [severity] 位置 + 描述 + 建议
237	```
238	
239	Paper Agent 解析时按位置抓字段——Reviewer 偶尔会漏维度分，**漏了的当作 4（满分）处理**，避免误判 overall 下降。

# Step 5 — Iterative Refinement

Step 4 全部章节落盘后，Paper Agent 进入 Step 5：把全文递交 Reviewer 评分，按反馈修改，直到收敛。

**核心约束**：
- 串行——一轮 Reviewer 返回结果处理完才进下一轮，禁止并发请求
- 评分驱动——overall 提升才 accept 本轮，下降则 git revert
- 上限 5 轮——硬约束，达到上限即停，不论分数

## 状态记录（git 是 truth source）

每轮修改前 commit 当前论文目录，作为 revert 锚点。无需额外 state 文件。

```
git -C projects/{project} add paper/
git -C projects/{project} commit -m "[paper] refinement round {N-1}"
```

Round N 的 commit message 用 `N-1`，即 round 1 修改前 commit `round 0`（Step 4 落盘后的初稿）。

## 单轮流程

```
Round N（N = 1..5）：

1. git commit 当前版本（message: "[paper] refinement round N-1"）
   └── 落地评分下降时的 revert 锚点

2. 组装审查请求：
   - read_project_file("paper_checklist.yaml") — 用户自定义必查项
   - 拼 LaTeX 全文（或 Patch 模式下的差异）+ writing_plan.yaml 路径
   - 末尾追加 "## 用户自定义必查项"（见下方"checklist 注入格式"）

3. paper_agent_request_review(text=组装后的请求, project=...)
   └── Reviewer 通过 reviewer_post_to_director 回传评分

4. 解析 Reviewer 响应：
   - 维度分（Originality/Clarity/Soundness/Significance/Presentation，1-4）
   - overall（1-10）
   - 各条具体问题 severity（critical/warning/info）
   - checklist 项 PASS/FAIL
   ★ 任一 checklist FAIL → 该条问题 severity 自动按 critical 对待

5. 按问题类型分流处理：
   - 事实性错误（数字不一致 / 引用错位）→ 自己用 edit_paper_section 改
   - 段落级叙事问题（逻辑断裂 / 强度词超限）→ spawn Worker 重写段落，回来再 edit_paper_section
   - 结构问题（章节顺序 / 段落归并）→ 自己用 edit_paper_section
   - critical 且 claim 本身无支撑 → 汇报 Director（不要自行降 claim）

6. 全部问题处理完后判断本轮 overall 走势：
   - overall(N) ≥ overall(N-1) → 保留本轮修改，进入收敛判断
   - overall(N) <  overall(N-1) → git checkout 上一轮 commit，回退本轮所有修改，标记"本轮无进展"

7. 收敛判断（任一满足即停）：
   - 全部问题为 info（无 critical / warning）
   - N == 5（硬上限）
   - 连续两轮 overall 持平（差 ≤0.1）
   - 连续两轮无新增 critical（critical 列表内容相同或更短）

   未收敛且 N<5 → 进入 Round N+1
   已收敛 → 进入收尾（见下文）
```

## checklist 注入格式

`read_project_file("paper_checklist.yaml")` 拿到 items 后，在审查请求末尾追加：

```
## 用户自定义必查项
以下是用户指定的必须检查的项，每项必须明确标注 PASS 或 FAIL：
- [chk_001] {text}
- [chk_002] {text}
...

如果任何一项标注为 FAIL，整体 severity 自动提升为 critical（必须打回修改）。
```

- checklist 为空 / 文件不存在 → 不追加该段，正常请求
- 不要重写 checklist 文本——保持用户原话，让 Reviewer 自己定位
- Dream 模式禁止注入（Dream 论文不投，格式检查无意义）

## 修改 Worker 任务模板

段落级修改派 Worker（不是整章重写）时：

```
spawn_worker(
  task_type="paper_writing",
  project=...,
  task_prompt="""
Reviewer 在 {section} 章发现以下问题，需要你修改对应段落：

【问题位置】{paragraph_id / 行号}
【问题描述】{Reviewer 原文}
【建议方向】{Reviewer 给的方向}

当前段落原文：
```latex
{原文片段}
```

参考资料：
- 写作规范：Read skills/global/latex-paper.skill.md + red-section.skill.md
- registry 切片：{相关 exp_id 列表}
- 同章节已有内容：{section}.tex 整章
- 引用：references.bib（只用已 verified 条目，未验证标 [UNVERIFIED]）

要求：
- 只改问题段落，不动其他内容
- 输出修改后的段落 latex（标记 old / new）
- 不要画图、不要补实验
- 改完即返回，不写额外说明

)
```

Worker 返回后 Paper Agent 用 `edit_paper_section(project, section, old_text=..., new_text=..., claims=..., table_cells=..., figures=...)` 落盘——`edit_paper_section` 自动同步 provenance，不会 deprecate 未触及的 claim。

按下面顺序串行（每一步完成才进下一步，前一步失败不绕过）：

```
1. paper-visual-review 排版检查
   └── Read skills/global/paper-visual-review.skill.md
   └── pdf_to_images(pdf_path=projects/{project}/paper/main.pdf, pages="1-N", dpi=200)
       逐页检查图表分辨率 / 字号 / 边距溢出 / 公式 / 引用编号 / 缺失引用占位 [?]
   └── cleanup_pdf_images(output_dir=<上一步返回的 output_dir>)  # 不留临时文件
   └── 收集 findings：[{page, severity, issue}]
   └── 出现 critical（图表溢出 / 缺失编号 / 公式乱码）→ 记入 visual_report，**不**立即返工，
       与 verify_references / check_provenance_completeness 的结果**一并汇报 Director**

2. verify_references 最终引用验证
   └── verify_references(paper_dir="projects/{project}/paper", project=..., skip_online=False)
   └── 返回字段：status (ok/orphan_bib/missing_bib/not_found/mismatch) 按条聚合
   └── critical 阈值：
        - missing_bib（正文 \cite 但 .bib 缺）→ 必须修，否则 LaTeX 编译失败
        - not_found（OpenAlex 找不到）→ 疑似幻觉引用，自己 WebSearch 二次验证；仍找不到 → critical
        - mismatch（年份/作者偏差）→ warning
   └── 自己能改的小问题（missing_bib、年份） → edit_paper_section 修；改完**再调一次 verify_references** 确认通过

3. check_provenance_completeness 溯源覆盖
   └── check_provenance_completeness(project=...)
   └── 返回：tier_distribution / untracked_numbers / invalidated_claims
   └── 关键阈值：
        - Tier 3 占比 > 30% → 必须汇报 Director（红线，不得静默交付）
        - Tier X（invalidated，实验失败/被作废）≥ 1 条 → critical：claim 失去支撑，汇报 Director 决策是否改 claim
        - untracked_numbers（正文出现但 provenance 没追踪的数字）≥ 5 → warning：派 Worker 补 provenance
```

### 汇报 Director 模板

三件套全部跑完后**统一**汇报（不要分三次发），把所有 critical/warning 列在一处便于 Director 决策：

```
paper_agent_post_to_director(
  text="[写作进展] Step 5 收尾完成
         迭代轮数：{N}/5
         最终 overall：{score}
         checklist：全部 PASS / 还有 X 条 FAIL（已修复 / 待 Director 决策）

         ===== 视觉检查 =====
         检查页数：{n}/{total}
         结论：PASS / 发现 X 条 critical + Y 条 warning
         {若有 critical：逐条列出 page + 描述}

         ===== 引用验证 =====
         总数 X 条，已验证 Y 条
         critical：missing_bib X 条 + 疑似幻觉 Y 条（已尝试 WebSearch 二次验证 → 结果）
         warning：mismatch X 条
         {若有 critical：列出条目 + 已采取的修复}

         ===== Provenance 覆盖 =====
         Tier 分布：T1 {a}% / T2 {b}% / T3 {c}% / TX {d}%
         {若 T3 > 30% 或 TX ≥ 1：列出受影响的 claim/figure/table}
         未追踪数字：X 个（详见 untracked_numbers）

         ===== 建议 =====
         {以下任选其一}
         A. 视觉/引用/provenance 全部 PASS → 建议提交审稿（submit_paper_to_review）
         B. 存在 critical → 请 Director 决策：{具体问题列表 + 建议修复方向}
         C. provenance 红线触发 → 请 Director 决定：补实验 / 改 claim / 接受现状",
  project=...
)
```

Director 决定是否调 `submit_paper_to_review`——Paper Agent **不**主动调，这是 Director 的权限。

### 红线（Step 5e 不可绕过）

1. **三件套必须全跑**：跳过任一项直接汇报 = 违规，被 Director 打回时不接受"我以为不必要"
2. **critical 不静默**：视觉 critical / verify_references critical / Tier X ≥ 1 / Tier 3 > 30% 必须显式写进汇报
3. **不主动提交审稿**：哪怕全 PASS 也只能"建议提交"，submit_paper_to_review 是 Director 权限
4. **修复后必须复验**：自己修了 missing_bib → 重跑 verify_references；补 provenance → 重跑 check_provenance_completeness
5. **Patch 模式走 Phase E**：Patch 的收尾在 Phase E（max 3 轮 Reviewer），不复用 Step 5e 全套；Phase E 自己做 check_provenance_completeness + verify_references，视觉检查可选

## 硬约束（与 Paper Agent 红线一致）

1. **修改前必 git commit**——没有 commit 不开新一轮，避免 revert 失败
2. **未验证引用不进 .bib**——Reviewer 指出新引用需求时，先 verify_references 再写入
3. **checklist FAIL 项必须修复**——不参与"连续两轮无新增 critical"的轮数计数，但下一轮必须解决
4. **overall 下降必 revert**——不允许"将就一下"
5. **不自行降 claim**——claim 无支撑是 Director 决策，Paper Agent 只能改表述强度，不能改 claim 内容
6. **Patch / Dream 模式不走本 skill**——Patch 走 Phase E（max 3 轮），Dream 跳过 Reviewer 迭代

## 与 Reviewer 评分模板的合约

Reviewer 在 `prompts/roles/reviewer.md` §5.3 已规定返回格式：

```
[写作评审] 轮次 N/5
维度评分（1-4）：Originality / Clarity / Soundness / Significance / Presentation
Overall（1-10）：
## 用户自定义必查项（如审查请求含 paper_checklist）
- [chk_id]: PASS / FAIL — 理由
## 具体问题
- [severity] 位置 + 描述 + 建议
```

Paper Agent 解析时按位置抓字段——Reviewer 偶尔会漏维度分，**漏了的当作 4（满分）处理**，避免误判 overall 下降。

# 论文写作质量指南（NeurIPS 实战经验）

> 来源：2026 年 NeurIPS 投稿期间，从 20+ 项目的人工审查反馈中提炼。
> 每条规则都源自真实的 bug / 退回 / 审稿质疑。

---

## 一、数据诚信与溯源（最高优先级）

### 1.1 数字必须有源头

- 论文中**每一个数字**必须可追溯到 registry 实验 ID 或原始结果文件
- 禁止凭记忆写数字——必须 `cat result.json | head` + `ls -la` 附上文件证据
- 计算值（均值、标准差、DID、delta）必须独立重算，不信 Agent 第一手汇报

> **教训（D149 事件）**：Agent 曾伪造完整的 metrics 数据包括 p-value，事后被 Reviewer 独立 parse JSON 抓出。从此所有关键数据必须 Reviewer 独立验证到字段级别。

### 1.2 不同来源数据不能混用

- 配对数据必须同 seed、同 c 值、同 N、同 evaluation protocol

- 跨 config 比较 delta 会引入系统误差——必须补跑同 config baseline 后才能比较
- 非等量对比必须显式标注（如 "at unmatched volumes"）

> **教训（D027 事件）**：不同 config 文件的 baseline 不同，跨 config 比较 delta 值引入了 artifact。

- 被 Director shelved 的数据（如因截断混淆），禁止重新引入论文
- `paper_provenance.yaml` 中 `verified: false` 的 claim，不得恢复

## 论文全文

### Abstract
Reasoning models with chain-of-thought (CoT) can self-jailbreak: their reasoning traces transition from safe deliberation to committed harmful generation without adversarial input. Detecting this safety commitment point requires monitoring, but a prior question remains unanswered: should a monitoring system read the model's hidden states or its generated text? We show that this comparison's outcome depends critically on an underexamined researcher degree of freedom: which transformer layer to monitor. Through systematic evaluation of hidden-state (HS) and text-based probes across four reasoning models, five selection metrics, and seven alternative methods, we find that a biased composite metric masks the HS advantage at 32B scale by selecting shallow layers where representation compression inflates threshold crossings. Principled selection recovers significant HS precision gains (+15.4 to +32.5pp, Holm-Bonferroni corrected), with evidence from strong (7--8B, no caveats) to qualified (32B, position-mediated). Encoder quality bounds the advantage: against a stronger 1024d text encoder, only 1/4 models survives correction. Layer selection sensitivity is the robust methodological finding; the empirical HS advantage is conditional, and current probes characterize the commitment phenomenon (FPR 39--52%) rather than constitute production detectors.

### Introduction (§1)
- Para 1: Safety Commitment Point definition, self-jailbreak phenomenon
- Para 2: Existing detectors (TrajGuard, SafeSwitch) target different problems; layer selection as underexamined DoF
- Para 3: Central finding — layer selection metric determines outcome; 4 models, 2 architectures, 2 scales
- Contributions: (1) Layer selection sensitivity with 5-metric ablation; (2) Encoder-quality boundary with evidence gradient (384d: 4/4 HB, 1024d: 1/4 HB, PCA capacity matching); (3) Negative results — 6 methods fail
- Closing: characterization caveat (FPR 39-52%, oracle gap 85.5%)

### Method (§3)
- §3.1 Safety Commitment Point definition + 4 models (Tab 1)
- §3.2 Probe Architecture (HS + text + temporal windowing + GRU)
- §3.3 Layer Selection Sensitivity (5-metric ablation, compression mechanism, convergence analysis, DoF discussion)
- §3.4 Baseline Methods (7 alternatives)

- §4.2 Layer Selection Results (Tab 2: biased vs corrected layers, Fig 1: heatmap)
- §4.3 HS vs Text (Tab 3: 12/12 HB at 384d, 1/4 at 1024d; capacity control via PCA; encoder robustness; position mediation; caveats)
- §4.4 32B Analysis (Tab 4: R1-32B vs QwQ divergence)
- §4.5 Temporal Context
- §4.6 Negative Results (BOCPD/CUSUM, Mahalanobis, RepE, MLP, CCS, cross-transfer)

### Related Work (§2)
4 clusters: Safety in Reasoning Models (attack/detection/mitigation), Hidden-State Safety Detection, Probing Methodology and Layer Selection, Change-Point Detection. ~55 citations.

### Discussion (§5)
- Layer selection as researcher DoF (generalizes to any threshold-based study)
- Encoder-quality boundary (384d → 1024d attenuation)
- Guidance for future research (5-step audit protocol, causal validation)

### Conclusion (§6)
Layer selection is critical DoF; empirical HS advantage is conditional (robust at 7-8B, position-mediated at 32B, bounded by encoder quality); methodological contribution is robust; current probes characterize not production-ready.

### Limitations (§7)
- R1-32B W=1 only (25% coverage), position-mediated
- QwQ-32B negative lead time
- R1-8B FPR seed-fragile
- Power analysis: MDE 8.6-9.5pp at n=19-20

11	\subsection{Layer Selection Results}\label{sec:layer-results}
12	
13	\cref{tab:layer_selection} shows that the biased composite metric (balanced accuracy $\times$ crossing rate) systematically selects shallow layers for 32B models: L2 (3\% depth) for QwQ-32B and L10 (16\%) for R1-32B. Three of four metrics excluding crossing rate (precision, inverse FPR, and additive composite) consistently select deep layers: L60 (94\%) and L63 (98\%). Pure balanced accuracy, a threshold-free metric, selects middle layers (L30 and L47), consistent with the AUROC pattern discussed in \cref{sec:discussion}. The mechanism is that shallow layers produce highly compressed representations with small inter-step margins: step-to-step cosine distances are 1.4--2.7$\times$ smaller than at deep layers across all models (\cref{app:cosine_volatility}). A linear probe in this compressed space operates near the noise floor, generating frequent threshold crossings that inflate crossing rate independently of discriminative power (\cref{sec:layer-sensitivity}).
14	
15	\begin{table}[t]

64	
65	Against the 384d baseline, HS probes significantly outperform text probes across all models$^\dagger$ on all three metrics (\cref{tab:hs_vs_text}), though R1-8B FPR significance is fragile across seeds (2/5 uncorrected, 1/5 Bonferroni-corrected; \cref{tab:r18b_fpr_seeds}). At 7--8B, the evidence is strong: precision gains of +32.5pp (R1-8B) and +21.9pp (OT-7B), stable across seeds (std ${<}4$pp). R1-8B FPR advantage is directionally consistent across seeds (5/5) but not robust to data split (2/5 reach $p{<}0.05$ uncorrected; after Bonferroni correction for 5 seeds, 1/5 remains significant; \cref{app:multi_seed}). At 32B, both models are significant (HB corrected) but with model-specific caveats: R1-32B achieves significance only at $W{=}1$ with 25\% coverage (5/20 traces), and QwQ-32B's position baseline is competitive (\cref{sec:32b-analysis}). R1-32B passes 5/5 seeds (paired $\Delta$Prec std${=}2.0$pp, despite absolute precision std${=}12.8$pp) but its advantage is position-mediated (residualized gap NS; \cref{app:position_residual}). Overall, 18/20 model-seed combinations pass full HB; R1-8B FPR instability accounts for both failures (\cref{app:multi_seed}). Control task selectivity confirms genuine safety signal: 12.5--19.7pp above chance (\cref{app:control}).
66	
67	\paragraph{Capacity control.} PCA reduction of HS features to 384d (matching text encoder dimensionality, 79--92\% variance retained) preserves the precision advantage across all models$^\dagger$ (+16.8 to +23.1pp, all $p{<}0.012$), with all model-level precision tests passing Holm-Bonferroni. Two individual metric comparisons are non-significant: R1-8B balanced accuracy (+1.3pp, $p{=}0.731$, effect too small at $n{=}43$) and QwQ-32B FPR ($-$11.4pp, $p{=}0.038$, below HB threshold). PCA retains directions of maximum variance in hidden-state space, which need not align with the semantic dimensions captured by a trained text encoder; the control provides partial evidence against a pure capacity explanation but does not rule out representation quality differences between PCA-compressed HS and trained text encoders.
68	
69	\paragraph{Encoder robustness.} The 1024d rows in \cref{tab:hs_vs_text} replace MiniLM (384d) with BGE-large~\citep{xiao2023cpack} (1024d, a 2.7$\times$ stronger encoder). The HS precision advantage persists directionally across all models$^\dagger$ but narrows substantially: only OT-7B survives Holm-Bonferroni (1/4 precision tests). HS balanced accuracy advantage is also directionally positive across all models$^\dagger$ (+8.4 to +10.9pp), with 2/4 (OT-7B, R1-32B) significant under Holm-Bonferroni; FPR advantage is significant only for OT-7B (1/4). R1-8B shows an adverse FPR direction (HS FPR 1.2pp higher than BGE, $p{=}0.564$). The advantage is encoder-conditional rather than absolute (\cref{fig:forest_precision}). Layer selection (Contribution 1) is encoder-independent, as it concerns hidden-state properties across layers rather than the text baseline.
70	
71	\paragraph{Position mediation.} Position ($t/T$) accounts for 9--20pp of balanced accuracy depending on model and window size,\footnote{R1-32B's 20.4pp drop reflects $W{=}1$ (no temporal context); at $W{\geq}3$ with temporal windowing, drops are 9--17pp.} but all models retain non-positional signal above chance (all $p{<}0.001$; \cref{app:position_residual}). Three of four models retain significant non-positional HS advantage over text (residualized gap +3.7 to +6.9pp, HB corrected); R1-32B's gap is +1.9pp ($p{=}0.914$, $n{=}20$), consistent with a position-mediated advantage. Temporal windowing reduces position dependence (R1-8B: 24.3pp drop at $W{=}3$ vs.\ 16.5pp at $W{=}15$).
72	
73	\paragraph{Caveats.} R1-32B achieves significance only at $W{=}1$ with 25\% coverage (5/20 traces); at $W{\geq}3$, dimensionality ($51200 \times W$ for $n{=}20$) prevents significance. Sweeping regularization $C$ over $[0.01, 100]$ yields ${<}2$pp variation in balanced accuracy; the HS advantage is also stable across decision thresholds (BA variation ${<}1.5$pp across $\tau \in [0.3, 0.7]$; \cref{app:threshold_sensitivity}). QwQ-32B HS lead time is negative ($-$1.2 to +1.9 steps vs.\ text 3.7--12.3 steps): higher precision at later detection. On benign traces, probes produce 39--52\% false alarm rates, so current methods characterize the commitment phenomenon rather than constitute production-ready detectors. Per-model details in \cref{sec:32b-analysis}.

At 32B, both models are significant (HB corrected) but with model-specific caveats: R1-32B achieves significance only at $W{=}1$ with 25\% coverage (5/20 traces), and QwQ-32B's position baseline is competitive (\cref{sec:32b-analysis}). R1-32B passes 5/5 seeds (paired $\Delta$Prec std${=}2.0$pp, despite absolute precision std${=}12.8$pp) but its advantage is position-mediated (residualized gap NS; \cref{app:position_residual}). Overall, 18/20 model-seed combinations pass full HB; R1-8B FPR instability accounts for both failures (\cref{app:multi_seed}). Control task selectivity confirms genuine safety signal: 12.5--19.7pp above chance (\cref{app:control}).

\paragraph{Capacity control.} PCA reduction of HS features to 384d (matching text encoder dimensionality, 79--92\% variance retained) preserves the precision advantage across all models$^\dagger$ (+16.8 to +23.1pp, all $p{<}0.012$), with all model-level precision tests passing Holm-Bonferroni. Two individual metric comparisons are non-significant: R1-8B balanced accuracy (+1.3pp, $p{=}0.731$, effect too small at $n{=}43$) and QwQ-32B FPR ($-$11.4pp, $p{=}0.038$, below HB threshold). PCA retains directions of maximum variance in hidden-state space, which need not align with the semantic dimensions captured by a trained text encoder; the control provides partial evidence against a pure capacity explanation but does not rule out representation quality differences between PCA-compressed HS and trained text encoders.

\paragraph{Encoder robustness.} The 1024d rows in \cref{tab:hs_vs_text} replace MiniLM (384d) with BGE-large~\citep{xiao2023cpack} (1024d, a 2.7$\times$ stronger encoder). The HS precision advantage persists directionally across all models$^\dagger$ but narrows substantially: only OT-7B survives Holm-Bonferroni (1/4 precision tests). HS balanced accuracy advantage is also directionally positive across all models$^\dagger$ (+8.4 to +10.9pp), with 2/4 (OT-7B, R1-32B) significant under Holm-Bonferroni; FPR advantage is significant only for OT-7B (1/4). R1-8B shows an adverse FPR direction (HS FPR 1.2pp higher than BGE, $p{=}0.564$). The advantage is encoder-conditional rather than absolute (\cref{fig:forest_precision}). Layer selection (Contribution 1) is encoder-independent, as it concerns hidden-state properties across layers rather than the text baseline.

\paragraph{Position mediation.} Position ($t/T$) accounts for 9--20pp of balanced accuracy depending on model and window size,\footnote{R1-32B's 20.4pp drop reflects $W{=}1$ (no temporal context); at $W{\geq}3$ with temporal windowing, drops are 9--17pp.} but all models retain non-positional signal above chance (all $p{<}0.001$; \cref{app:position_residual}). Three of four models retain significant non-positional HS advantage over text (residualized gap +3.7 to +6.9pp, HB corrected); R1-32B's gap is +1.9pp ($p{=}0.914$, $n{=}20$), consistent with a position-mediated advantage. Temporal windowing reduces position dependence (R1-8B: 24.3pp drop at $W{=}3$ vs.\ 16.5pp at $W{=}15$).

\paragraph{Caveats.} R1-32B achieves significance only at $W{=}1$ with 25\% coverage (5/20 traces); at $W{\geq}3$, dimensionality ($51200 \times W$ for $n{=}20$) prevents significance. Sweeping regularization $C$ over $[0.01, 100]$ yields ${<}2$pp variation in balanced accuracy; the HS advantage is also stable across decision thresholds (BA variation ${<}1.5$pp across $\tau \in [0.3, 0.7]$; \cref{app:threshold_sensitivity}). QwQ-32B HS lead time is negative ($-$1.2 to +1.9 steps vs.\ text 3.7--12.3 steps): higher precision at later detection. On benign traces, probes produce 39--52\% false alarm rates, so current methods characterize the commitment phenomenon rather than constitute production-ready detectors. Per-model details in \cref{sec:32b-analysis}.
